hero.eyebrow: Open source · New BSD license · PHP 8
hero.tagLine: Nishchay means “decision”. It is an open structure PHP framework: choose MVC, HMVC or design your own structure, and start building.

showcase.title: Attributes, not boilerplate
showcase.subTitle: Routes and entities are declared with PHP attributes, right next to the code they describe.

route.title: Routes
route.text: Mark a public method with Route and it handles the request.

entity.title: Entities
entity.text: Map a class to a table and describe each property once.

console.title: Console
console.text: Generate code and inspect your application from the terminal.

features.title: Why Nishchay
features.subTitle: Everything you need to build web applications and REST services, with the structure left up to you.

openStructure.title: Open structure
openStructure.text: Use MVC, HMVC or design your own. Controllers, models, events and views all follow the structure you define.

database.title: Entities and queries
database.text: Map entity classes to tables with read-only, required and derived properties. Build simple to complex queries, with built-in caching and optional encryption of sensitive values.

session.title: Flexible sessions
session.text: Read-limit, till-next-request, scope and conditional sessions, stored in files, a database or a cache.

webService.title: Web services
webService.text: Turn the whole application, or selected routes, into a web service with JSON or XML responses, token-based access, field filtering and custom response formats.

maintenance.title: Maintenance modes
maintenance.text: Pause the application by browser, time range, date range or callback, while keeping chosen routes available.

console.title: Console commands
console.text: Create controllers and entities, inspect routes and events, and run GET routes from the terminal, which suits cron jobs.

steps.title: Up and running in three steps

install.title: Install
install.text: Create a project with Composer, or download the latest release ({version}).
install.note: Need help? See the installation guides.

configure.title: Configure
configure.text: Create your encryption key and set up your environment.

build.title: Build
build.text: Follow the get-started guide and create your first route.

learning.title: Learn at your own pace
learning.text: The Learning Center documents every feature topic by topic. Sign in to track your reading progress and keep private notes on any topic.

list.progress: Reading time and progress tracking when you are signed in

community.title: Join the community
community.subTitle: Nishchay is built in the open. Choose how you want to take part.

contributor.title: Contributor
contributor.tagLine: Make any of the following contributions to be promoted to a contributor account.

list.item2: Translate content into other languages or improve existing content

developer.title: Developer
developer.tagLine: Every new account is a developer account by default.

list.item1: Add notes to any topic in the Learning Center
list.item2: Save your reading progress and see it in your profile

list.item1: Submit your project to be listed on the website
list.item2: Track the reading progress of your developers

join.title: Make your decision
join.tagLine: Take up Nishchay and bring your ideas to life.
